Name: Skill Prestige (Unofficial Fix for 1.6.15)
Author: SaakiFeniya
Description:
Hello Guys,

I annoyed a friend of mine to make a fix for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/569]Skill Prestige[/url] mod by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/CinderGarde]CinderGarde[/url]
I will be taking down this page when CinderGarde updates their mod.

[size=4][font=Arial Black]Unofficial update:[/font][/size]

After some time and with lots of help from MangusuPixel.
I am happy to update the Skill Prestige Mod.
It now includes support a few more mods:
[list]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6830]The Love of Cooking[/url]   NEW[/b][/*]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24409]Ars Venefici[/url]    NEW [/b][/*]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12369]Sword and Sorcery[/url]    NEW [/b][/*]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39216]Cloths & Colors[/url]    NEW[/b][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38383][b]Wizardry[/b][/url][b]    NEW [/b](temporarily unavailable)[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14073]Binning[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22199]Archaeology[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14142]Socializing[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16820]Travelling[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22681]Yet Another Cooking Skill[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28103]Luck Skill[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23791]Scaring - Thieving Skill[/url][/*]
[/list]Feel free to report bugs or anything you find.
If CinderGarde wants me to take it down, i will do so immediately.

[url=https://github.com/MangusuPixel/SkillPrestige]GitHub source[/url]

[b][size=4]Credits[/size][/b]

[*]Thank you [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/CinderGarde]CinderGarde [/url]for making such a great mod, which is one of the mods i need all the time [/*]
[*]My good friend, who can code, and did the majority of the work (I am just testing and providing feels they need)
That friend is the Best <3[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/MangusuPixel]MangusuPixel [/url]([url=https://ko-fi.com/mangupix]Ko-fi[/url])  for helping fix bugs, adding The Love for Cooking, Cloths and Colors, Moonslimes Wizardry, Swords and Sorcery and adapted Ars Venifici[/*]

Includes support for The Love of Cooking, Ars Venefici, Sword and Sorcery, Cloths & Colors, Binning, Archaeology, Socializing, Travelling, Yet Another Cooking Skill, Luck Skill and Thieving Skill

Manifest.Name: SkillPrestige
Manifest.Description: Lets you earn permanent profession perks beyond that which can normally be obtained in Vanilla play by spending Prestige Points, earned by resetting a skill from 10 to 0.
Manifest.Author: CinderGarde

Manifest.Description: Extends Skill Prestige to add support for Wizardry by MoonSlime.
